reviews.title: iHeart Radio Ads
reviews.text: There’s a certain news channel in Sacramento (you can probably guess it, traffic reports every 10 minutes and takes entirely too long to get to the point of an announced news story that they’ll keep announcing but eventually get to) that has an online stream through iHeart. Those ads are the worst and possibly were made that way on purpose.

reviews.title: Eh?????
reviews.text: This app is so hit and miss. Been listening to Virgin Radio britpop(90’s) but overnight, this station is not available in my region????? All the other Virgin stations are, but looks like Virgin 90’s has moved to the moon?? Might as well as far as this app is concerned. Just downloaded the Virgin Radio app and also got Talk Radio on there too so ditching this app now. Really poor. Had this app years, but might as well download Global too, and this can go do one. Only got one job, and that’s to play a radio station, and now it can’t do that. Not fit for purpose. The search menu is tripe too.

reviews.title: SEVENS Radio Network UNSAT
reviews.text:
Tagging up the way SEVENS Radio Network the way you did is VERY SAD. Either you listen to nothing but commercials or you pay their premium price (10.00 a month) just to have all the commercials that SEVENS has implanted to keep the station “Free”. Horrible!! Garth you are and have always been amazing to me and I listened to no other station when you were on Sirius but this insane. I would rather pay to listen to your music, and your choices of music, than listening to commercials. Almost EVERYBODY has a pay for no commercials. Let’s get with the times!
By the way, I have also bought everything you have ever released. So, I am not just someone complaining. 
            Your Fan

I just want to get to my favourite stations when I open the app 🤷‍♂️

reviews.title: Mind Numbing Repetitive Ads
reviews.text:
The same ads are played over and over and over again. Sometimes the same ad is played back to back to back. Ads never change month after month after month. Terrible!
Probably their motivation for the repetitive ads is to get you to pay for the monthly subscription. The ads persuading you to buy the monthly subscription are frequently back to back!  Make it stop!

reviews.title: Way too many commercials!
reviews.text: Something is haywire on my TuneIn app on my phone. It plays a commercial about every minute or so for several minutes. Then works fine for a little while, then starts the cycle over. It used to play commercials about every half hour which is acceptable, but now it’s way outta whack!

reviews.title: Same advert for the last four months
reviews.text: Ruined by having the same advert played constantly. Now deleted.

reviews.title: Record
reviews.text: Unfortunately the ability to record shows is no longer available.

reviews.title: STOP PROMPTING TO RATE TUNEIN!
reviews.text: Every time I open the app it’s asking me if I’m enjoying the TuneIn. I say no because this app sucks and then it redirects me to Safari to contact support. I contacted support to tell them stop prompting for feedback, and they wanted a video of what’s happening! Read the words of my complaint and look at your own app. I can’t be the only person annoyed by this. Stop bothering users.

reviews.title: Stop poking us in the eye
reviews.text: Bad enough that they took away a lot of features but now with the latest update it forced me to log back in again, stop poking the customers in the eye but give them what they want

reviews.title: Paid for full app years ago, but now it doesn’t work?
reviews.text: I’m really sick of having paid for a full app only to have the company go to a subscription service and not honor the full paid versions from before. Tune in used to offer a full paid version of the app and now won’t restore that previous purchase.

reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.text: I’ve been subscribing to the “premium” in the premium app for many years. I would still get ads and the premium app wouldn’t sync up with my apple subscription. I reached out multiple times to customer service who promised to get back to me with an answer but the answer was always “so sorry but our tech team are still working on a fix”. In the end I’ve given up and cancelled my subscription.
